purpose: Define the first protected real-business vertical cases without publishing questions, source data, credentials, or gold answers.

cases.entry_contract: A normal product client submits a protected business-location question against explicitly authorized enterprise sources.
cases.blocker: protected holdout and authorized enterprise source were not supplied to this repository run

cases.entry_contract: A normal product client requests an exact protected statistic with fixed population, time, grouping, join, deduplication and precision semantics.
required_receipts: query execution id and query fingerprint
cases.blocker: protected gold data and authorized query source were not supplied to this repository run
